description: Na₂La₂PtO₆ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.42 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.43 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.51-2.91 Å. There are three inequivalent La sites. In the first La site, La is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of La-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.90 Å. In the second La site, La is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of La-O bond distances ranging from 2.53-2.64 Å. In the third La site, La is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of La-O bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.72 Å. Pt is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Pt-O bond distances ranging from 2.04-2.09 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two Na, three La, and one Pt atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to two Na, three La, and one Pt atom to form distorted ONa₂La₃Pt octahedra that share corners with ten ONa₂La₃Pt octahedra, edges with four ONa₃La₂Pt octahedra, and faces with four ONa₂La₃Pt octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-64°. In the third O site, O is bonded to three Na, two La, and one Pt atom to form distorted ONa₃La₂Pt octahedra that share corners with thirteen ONa₂La₃Pt octahedra, edges with four ONa₃La₂Pt octahedra, and faces with three ONa₃La₂Pt octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-67°. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two Na, three La, and one Pt atom to form distorted ONa₂La₃Pt octahedra that share corners with twelve ONa₂La₃Pt octahedra, edges with four ONa₃La₂Pt octahedra, and faces with four ONa₃La₂Pt octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-56°. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to three Na, two La, and one Pt atom to form ONa₃La₂Pt octahedra that share corners with twelve ONa₂La₃Pt octahedra, edges with four ONa₂La₃Pt octahedra, and faces with four ONa₃La₂Pt octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-64°. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two Na, three La, and one Pt atom to form distorted ONa₂La₃Pt octahedra that share corners with fourteen ONa₂La₃Pt octahedra,  an edgeedge with one ONa₂La₃Pt octahedra, and faces with five ONa₃La₂Pt octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 19-67°.
